# AiButton

```ts
import { AiButton } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

The one primary action an AI response offers — "Start deployment plan", "Open report". Use it inside AI conversations, usually through AiMessageResponse's action prop. Ordinary actions use Button.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | Visible label — name the action ("Start deployment plan"). |
| `segment` | `AiSegment` | `'consumer'` | AI segment — sets the fill gradient and label color. |
| `icon` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional 16px leading icon (inherits the label color). |

Also accepts all `React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<AiButton icon={<ArrowRight />}>Start deployment plan</AiButton>
<AiButton segment="commercial">Open report</AiButton>
<AiButton segment="internal" icon={<Sparkles />}>Summarize</AiButton>
<AiButton disabled>Start deployment plan</AiButton>
```

## Design tokens used

`--color-ai-`, `--type-size-caption`, `--radius-1000`, `--space-100`, `--space-250`, `--space-050`, `--elevation-1`, `--color-disabled-disabled`, `--color-disabled-disabled-inverse`, `--stroke-300`, `--color-primary-primary`

## Accessibility

- A native button named by its label; the icon is decorative.
- Focus is restyled, never removed.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use for the single action an AI response offers | Use for ordinary page actions |
| Name the outcome ("Start deployment plan") | Write "Go" or "OK" |
| Match the segment of the surrounding AI input | Mix segments in one conversation |
